scenes.say: A year ago Red Bull dropped him after two races. Now he has a contract for twenty twenty-seven.
Liam Lawson started last season as Verstappen's team-mate, then got sent back to the junior team after two rounds.
This year he has eighty-nine points. That's more than the whole Alpine team.
In Brazil he started third and even passed Norris, who went on to win the race.
Points in fifteen of twenty Grands Prix. Only six drivers from top teams have been more consistent.
Rookie Arvid Lindblad stays too, so Red Bull junior Tsolov has to wait.
Lawson's points and the whole grid are on LapRadar.

title: Lawson stays at Racing Bulls: from written off to his best season
